'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]], [[Killing of journalists in the Gaza war]]
***Five journalists of the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]]-affiliated Al Quds Today TV are killed in their vehicle by an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] near the [[Al-Awda Hospital]] in [[Deir al-Balah Governorate]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/12/25/middleeast/journalists-death-israeli-strike-gaza-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-834930 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[Winter of 2024–25 in the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip evacuations]]
***Gaza Strip doctors report that three infants have died due to [[hypothermia]] from inadequate shelter in displacement camps amid a decrease in outdoor temperatures. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/12/26/live-israel-pounds-gaza-as-three-babies-freeze-to-death-in-tent-camps (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[December 2024 Israeli airstrikes in Yemen]]
***Israel carries out a series of airstrikes between [[Sanaa]] and [[Hodeidah]] in [[Yemen]], hitting a number of facilities, including [[Sanaa International Airport]], and killing at least six people and injuring at least 40 others with the [[Director-General of the World Health Organization]] [[Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus]] present. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/26/israel-strikes-yemens-sanaa-airport-other-key-sites-reports (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/12/26/live-israel-pounds-gaza-as-three-babies-freeze-to-death-in-tent-camps?update=3409797 (Al Jazeera 2)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/b15bx1jsjx (YNet)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyj88rye1jo (BBC)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|American military intervention in Somalia]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] confirms the death of Mohamed Mire Jama, a senior leader of the group, who had been designated as a terrorist by the [[United States]], in an American [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] near Kunyo Baroow, [[Hirshabelle State]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.idilnews.com/u-s-drone-strike-kills-senior-al-shabaab-commander-in-kunyo-baroow-lower-shabelle-somalia/ (''Idil News'')] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/al-shabaab-confirms-death-of-us-designated-leader-in-somalia-airstrike (Garowe Online)] [https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2024/12/shabaab-announces-the-death-of-senior-official-mohamed-mire.php (Long WaR Journal)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**A [[Nigerian Air Force]] jet mistakenly kills ten [[civilian]]s in [[Sokoto State]], [[Nigeria]], during a bombing raid targeting armed groups in the state, according to [[List of governors of Sokoto State|state governor]] [[Ahmad Aliyu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-10-killed-after-nigerian-military-jet-targeting-bandits-bomb-civilians-2024-12-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis]]
**The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Office for National Statistics]] announces that the [[Economy of the United Kingdom|UK economy]] showed [[Economic stagnation|no growth]] in the 3rd quarter of the current fiscal year, following downward revisions. [https://apnews.com/article/britain-economy-growth-labour-f680c1856d2df2d038f9027942444d48 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243]]
**[[Politics of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani government]] officials tell [[Reuters]] that a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] [[surface-to-air missile]] launched from a [[Pantsir missile system|Pantsir-S missile system]] was responsible for the [[Azerbaijan Airlines]] plane crash that killed 38 people yesterday. Officials also say that the aircraft's [[Global Positioning System|GPS navigation system]] was jammed during the flight. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/26/exclusive-preliminary-investigation-confirms-russian-missile-over-grozny-caused-aktau-cras (Euronews)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/azerbaijan-airlines-flight-was-downed-by-russian-air-defence-system-four-sources-2024-12-26/ (Reuters)]
**[[National Assembly (Azerbaijan)|Azerbaijan MP]] [[Rasim Musabayov]] calls for an apology and accountability from [[Russia]] following their alleged involvement in the crash of the Azerbaijan Airlines flight. [https://united24media.com/latest-news/azerbaijani-mp-demands-apology-from-russia-for-downing-civilian-plane-4735 (United24Media)]
**[[Azerbaijan Airlines]] says that they will provide compensation for the victims and families of those who died in the plane crash. [https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/3987248.html (Trend)]
*[[Hadsel bus accident]]
**Three people are killed and at least four others are injured when a bus carrying 58 people [[Roadway departure|crashes into a lake]] in [[Hadsel Municipality]], [[Norway]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckg1889kn8lo (BBC News)] [https://www.nrk.no/nordland/bussulykken-pa-e10-i-vesteralen_-yngvar-gustavsen-var-blant-de-forste-pa-ulykkesstedet-1.17183713 (NRK)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Lobitos oil spill]]
**The [[Government of Peru]] declares a 90-day [[Environmental emergency|environmental emergency]] for parts of [[Talara province]] due to an oil spill caused by state-owned oil company [[Petroperú]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/peru-declares-environmental-emergency-after-oil-spill-2024-12-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Baltic Sea submarine cable disruptions]], [[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[2024 Estlink 2 incident]]
***[[Finland|Finnish]] [[border guard]]s and [[Police of Finland|police]] detain a [[Russia]]n vessel suspected of damaging the [[Estlink|Estlink-2]] [[submarine power cable]] yesterday. [https://apnews.com/article/eu-finland-estonia-baltic-sea-power-cable-6741ef1ce9130602abac6214d7297717 (AP)]
*[[Chad–France relations]], [[French military withdrawal from West Africa (2022–present)|French military withdrawal from West Africa]]
**[[France]] hands over its military first base in [[Chad]], at [[Faya-Largeau]], as part of the withdrawal of all its forces from the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/26/france-hands-over-first-base-in-chad-amid-withdrawal-from-former-colony (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Philippines–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] [[pardon]]s 220 [[Filipinos in the United Arab Emirates|Filipino]] detainees for various offenses as part of its [[National Day (United Arab Emirates)|National Day]] celebrations, following discussions between [[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] and [[President of the United Arab Emirates|UAE President]] [[Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan]]. [https://qa.philstar.com/headlines/2025/01/06/2412282/uae-pardons-220-detained-filipinos (''The Philippine Star'')]
